name: Sankyo Co., Ltd.
summary: Sankyo Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells game machines and ball bearing supply systems in Japan. It operates through the Pachinko Machines Business, Pachislot Machines Business, Supply Equipment Related Business, and Other Businesses segments. The Pachinko Machines Business segment produces and sells pachinko machines, machine gauges, and related parts. The Pachinko Machines Business segment produces and sells pachislot machines and sells related parts. The Supply Equipment Related Business segment produces and sells pachinko and pachislot replenishment device, card system equipment, and hall equipment peripherals.
